facts.fact: PTI reports that Lei de Autorização Legislativa n.º 12/26 of 2 October 2026 authorises the President to legislate the Regime Jurídico da Assinatura Electrónica e da Certificação Digital (validity and legal effect of e-signatures, certification entities, ICP-AO) within 90 days of publication; the regime itself is not yet enacted.
